mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at 35 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park. We have a Full Moon tonight, and while the International Space Station will pass overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City property tax bills will be mailed by December 15. You can pay in two installments, with the first due January 31, using online credit card payments, mail, or the 24-hour drop boxes at the City Center.

It is a busy week for events. We have trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at recent reports, on November 6, officers were dispatched to a business where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle; she was later arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a delicious treat.
